Young Experts Program
Shaping the Future of Global IP
The WIPO Young Experts Program (YEP) supports the development of early-career professionals who are passionate about Intellectual Property (IP) and its role in driving innovation and sustainable development worldwide.
Through this 2-year competitive program, a select group of young and talented professionals will work first-hand on WIPO's various initiatives. The Program offers exposure to both technical and strategic aspects of IP, allowing YEP participants to gain skills and knowledge that can contribute to the future economic growth of their countries and regions.
This is a unique learning opportunity for your career – not only about IP, but also about collaboration, multilateralism and global impact.
Virtual Info Session - July 31, 2026
Please note
: The YEP is not intended as a vehicle for recruitment into WIPO but is designed to contribute to participants’ professional growth. As such, participants will not be allowed to apply for any jobs at WIPO during the program, nor in the one year following its completion.

"We’re investing in young, talented persons from diverse backgrounds, giving them the exposure needed to understand IP at both a technical and strategic level, as well as nurture them in leadership and administrative skills. In this way, we are not only providing a pathway to an enriching career, but also allowing them to contribute to the future economic growth of their countries and regions."
Director General Daren Tang

6 reasons why you should join WIPO's Young Expert Program
Unique on-the-job learning
As part of this program, you will learn about IP and the role of WIPO in promoting innovation and creativity for the benefit of all. The program has a blended learning format which includes on-the-job learning and academic training opportunities with our
WIPO Academy
.
Mentoring and guidance
As part of the program, you will be assigned mentors to help you hone your management and administrative skills and build your career. From day one, you will be exposed to interesting and impactful projects that will deepen your knowledge and skills.
International network
As part of the YEP community, you will have frequent networking opportunities with
senior leaders and IP experts
at WIPO. After the program, you will become part of a vibrant network of future global IP leaders, contributing to the development of the global IP ecosystem.
Work on pressing challenges
As a YEP professional, you will work on meaningful projects that address global challenges, such as climate change, by using IP, innovation, and creativity to find solutions.
Global community

As a YEP professional, you will work on meaningful projects that address global challenges, such as climate change, by using IP, innovation, and creativity to find solutions.
Global community
As part of a global program, you will work in an international agency with a workforce that comes from 120+ countries. This diverse environment will allow you to broaden your horizons and enrich your professional perspective.
Professional experience
As a YEP participant, you will see diplomacy and multilateralism up close, learning how to bridge differences and work toward consensus. As part of the WIPO Secretariat, young professionals will work on exciting IP projects to build their CVs for future opportunities back in the global IP landscape.
Meet some of our Young Experts alumni
Hear firsthand their experience of WIPO’s Young Experts Program (YEP)
“It expands your professional horizons and is a life changing experience.”
Magdalena, IP eLearning Section, Poland
"
Testimonial – “The WIPO’s YEP Program pushes you to challenge the status quo and enhances your curiosity. It gave me the opportunity to learn about resilience, adaptability, and open-mindedness. You witness multilateral negotiations on IP and diplomacy firsthand, providing a backstage pass to the global IP stage where critical decisions are made. Through this exposure, I gained a deeper understanding of the complexities and intricacies of IP and the UN system."
Magdalena Pisko – Young Expert
“We work together to increase IP rightsholders on the ground.”
Nuraiym, Office of the Assistant Director General (IES), Kyrgyzstan
"What I find so fulfilling as a Young Expert is that the projects I was involved in allowed me to help underprivileged IP rightsholders on the ground. My work and frequent interaction with senior leadership of WIPO helped me to enhance my understanding of the dynamics of multilateralism, multiculturalism and the differences in approaches taken by countries and different regions"
Nuraiym Iliiasova – Young Expert
“Being a YEP empowered me to make a global impact and contribute directly to innovation and creativity worldwide.”
Jorge, Division for Transition and Developed Countries (TDC), Mexico
"Becoming a YEP has been a life-changing journey, empowering me to apply my expertise to create a positive difference in society with a global reach. From interacting with amazing and experienced professionals, leaders, and peer YEPs, to working firsthand with society and other institutions, it has given me a deep insight into the international IP system at a strategic level, while also enabling me to impact innovators and creators directly."
Jorge Mar Corral – Young Expert

text:
Jorge Mar Corral – Young Expert
“It is a unique opportunity to work with top IP experts and shape a balanced IP landscape.”
Felipe, Division for Latin America and the Caribbean, Colombia
"Being part of the YEP is definitively a once-in-a-lifetime experience. Very few places will offer you the chance to work and learn from some of the brightest minds in IP Law, while understanding the ins and outs of diplomatic engagement. YEPs play a key role in several WIPO activities aimed to continue shaping a better and balanced IP landscape."
Felipe Martinez Sanchez – Young Expert
“It has transformed my career, allowing me to develop innovative AI solutions and gain invaluable mentorship.”
Lorenzo, Copyright Management Division, Italy
"This has been a transformative experience. As a computer engineer specialized in AI and machine learning, I have had the opportunity to contribute to innovative solutions, such as the AI-based speech-to-text system used for WIPO conferences. This project has showcased the significant impact of AI on improving accessibility and efficiency. The program has enriched my professional and personal growth, provided invaluable mentorship and expanded my professional network. I am grateful for the chance to make meaningful contributions and develop skills that will serve me throughout my career."
Lorenzo Concina
